2024-10-01.name: Rekishi ni Nokoru Akujo ni Naru zo
2024-10-01.desc:
This young girl hates all those goodie-two-shoes heroines. So when she’s reincarnated as Alicia, the villain in her favorite fantasy dating sim, it’s like a dream come true! There’s just one problem: the more she tries to be evil, the more the prince seems to fall for her. Alicia will have to work much harder if she ever wants to become the world’s greatest villainess.

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first episode received an early screening at Anime Messe Babelsberg in Germany on 20 July 2024, and at a special event at Animate Ikebukuro in
Tokyo on 20 September 2024. The regular broadcast started on 1 October 2024.

2024-10-01.name: Saikyou no Shien-shoku "Wajutsushi" Dearu Ore wa Sekai Saikyou Clan o Shitagaeru
2024-10-01.desc:
* Based on a fantasy light novel series written by Jaki and illustrated by Fame.

Noel longs to be a Seeker like his heroic grandfather, slaying the beasts that emerge from Abysses and exploring far-off lands. Unfortunately, it turns out he's nothing but a measly Talker–a job with no combat skills whatsoever. Undaunted, Noel sets out to establish the strongest clan in all the land, using his silver-tongued Talker skills to unite assassins and heroes under his leadership.

Source: Seven Seas Entertainment

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 15 September 2024 at Abema Anime Festival in Tokyo. The regular broadcast started on 1 October 2024.

2024-10-02.name: Acro Trip
2024-10-02.desc:
* Based on a shoujo comedy manga by Sawata Yone.

Date Chizuko is an otaku girl who lives in a city in Niigata Prefecture. Chizuko is obsessed with Berry Blossom, the magical girl who protects the city. However, Chroma — the leader of the local evil organization Fossa Magna — is inept and weak, so hardly anyone else cares about Berry Blossom and Chroma's frequent battles anymore. Chizuko vows to shine a light on the magical girl's exploits — and this fervent desire takes this seemingly shy middle school girl down a dark path filled with strange folks...

Source: ANN

2024-10-02.name: Amagami-san Chi no Enmusubi
2024-10-02.desc:
* Based on a romantic comedy manga by Naitou Marcey.

Kamihate Uryuu has had a rough start to life, but plans to forget it all by achieving his dream—matriculating into medical school. But when he arrives at his new foster home, a working shrine, his dream of a quiet place to study goes up in smoke. Not only will he be living with the three beautiful, lively Amagami sisters—but he learns that he must marry one of them and take over the temple!

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 15 September 2024 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 2 October 2024.

2024-10-02.name: Du Shi Gu Xian Yi
2024-10-02.desc:
Ye Bufan, a junior student, tried to scam a car owner in order to raise medical expenses for his mother. Unexpectedly, he encountered a female driver who did not play by the rules. After being hit, Ye Bufan accidentally traveled to a fantasy world and obtained the inheritance of ancient medicine. From then on, he mastered medical skills, practiced martial arts, and won the favor of countless beautiful women.

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2024-10-02.name: Shi Cao Lao Long Bei Guan Yi E Long Zhi Ming 2
2024-10-02.desc:
A herbivore dragon who wanted to live peacefully met a middle school sophomore girl Reko, who was seeking death. As he couldn't persuade the suicidal Reko, he had to lie to her to ensure she goes on living. Now, believing the words of the "Evil Dragon", Reko starts her journey to fight against the Demon King's army together with the most powerful "Evil Dragon".

Source: bilibili

2024-10-02.name: Wu Liuqi: Jiyi Suipian
2024-10-02.desc:
In order to find his cherished companions, Wu Liuqi returns to Xuanwu Country and faces those forgotten fragments of memory. The dusty truth brings pain and anger, but now he is no longer alone. What is the purpose of having power? This time, Wu Liuqi has to make a new choice for his life...

source: bgm.tv\googletranslate

2024-10-03.name: Ao no Hako
2024-10-03.desc:
Inomata Taiki loves badminton, but he has a long way to go before he can reach nationals. When Taiki sees upperclassman Kano Chinatsu practicing her heart out on the girls' basketball team, he falls for her hard. After an unexpected turn of events brings the two closer together, sports might not be the first thing on their minds anymore!

Source: Viz

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 7 September 2024 at TOHO Cinemas Hibiya in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 October 2024.

2024-10-03.name: Dungeon ni Deai o Motomeru no wa Machigatte Iru Darouka: Familia Myth V
2024-10-03.desc:
* Based on Oomori Fujino's light novel series.

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 16 September 2024 at Abema Anime Festival in Tokyo. Additionally, each episode was streamed on ABEMA, Crunchyroll, and HiDive two days ahead of its TV broadcast, starting on 3 October 2024. The regular broadcast started on 5 October 2024.

2024-10-03.name: Ji Yao Lu: Qicheng Pian
2024-10-03.desc:
Wu Daoying, a young man who is bent on finding monsters, quits his job in anger after getting tired of the perfunctory daily routine of a yamen runner. He follows Qingxuan on the road of hunting monsters. In the subsequent encounters with various monsters, he gradually breaks through himself, strengthens his beliefs, and finally overcomes the difficulties. He uses courage and compassion to achieve personal growth and save others.
　　The work is adapted from the novel "Wu Chengen's Monster Hunting".

source: movie.douban.com/googletranslate

2024-10-03.name: Kekkon Surutte, Hontou Desuka
2024-10-03.desc:
* Based on a romantic comedy manga by Wakaki Tamiki.

Takuya and Rika are coworkers in a travel agency in Tokyo. They're both single, but they don't mind, since they're introverts with fulfilling lives at home. Unfortunately, now their job is looking to staff an office in Alaska, and non-married employees are the first to be considered. Rika is desperate to avoid the transfer and goes to Takuya with an idea: if they pretend they're getting married in a year, they can stay in Tokyo. The only problem is the two of them barely know each other! If these two quiet coworkers "fake" a relationship, will it turn into something real?

Source: Seven Seas Entertainment

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 14 September 2024 at TOHO Cinemas Kinshicho Olinas in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 October 2024.

2024-10-03.name: Kinoko Inu
2024-10-03.desc:
Author Hotaru Yuyami has just tragically lost his beloved dog. While gazing at a tree in his yard, he notices a strange pink mushroom, and it's...moving?! The mushroom suddenly turns into an adorable dog, and Hotaru decides to take it in. Now, alongside his editor and a mushroom researcher, Hotaru shares heartwarming and hilarious moments with his new capricious companion.

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 8 September 2024 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 October 2024.

2024-10-03.name: NegaPosi Angler
2024-10-03.desc:
Tsunehiro's life isn't easy. After a doctor gives him two years to live and debt collectors come knocking, he falls from a bridge. In the knick of time, Hana and her crew spot Tsunehiro and pull him to safety. Before returning, they anchor offshore to fish and Tsunehiro catches a huge sea bass in a bout of beginner's luck. As his apartment building crumbles, Tsunehiro's new life begins to unfold!

Source: Crunchyroll

2024-10-03.name: Shin Tennis no Ouji-sama: U-17 World Cup Semifinal
2024-10-03.desc:
* Based on a tennis manga by Konomi Takeshi.

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 23 September 2024 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 October 2024.

2024-10-04.name: Dan Da Dan
2024-10-04.desc:
* Based on a paranormal mystery battle & romantic comedy manga by Tatsu Yukinobu.

Ayase Momo strikes up an unusual friendship with her school's UFO fanatic, whom she nicknames "Okarun" because he has a name that is not to be said aloud. While Momo believes in spirits, she thinks aliens are nothing but nonsense. Her new friend, meanwhile, thinks the exact opposite. To settle matters, the two set out to prove each other wrong—Momo to a UFO hotspot and Okarun to a haunted tunnel! What unfolds next is a beautiful story of young love...and oddly horny aliens and spirits?

Source: Viz

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 31 August 2024 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo, in Mexican cinemas on 5 September 2024, in Austrian, French, Belgian, Swiss, Italian, and French African cinemas on 7 September 2024, in German cinemas on 10 September 2024, in North American and British cinemas on 13 September 2024, and on 21 September 2024 at Nanba Parks Cinema in Osaka. The regular TV broadcast started on 4 October 2024.

Additionally, the first 6 episodes leaked in early August before the scheduled air date.

2024-10-04.name: Duel Masters Lost: Tsuioku no Suishou
Hamidashi Creative
2024-10-04.desc:
The anime will bring you the story of the five girls, which you couldn't see in the game, unfolding in the absence of the main character!
The girls have broken away from school refusal and are causing trouble beyond the framework of the student council, a youth comedy that begins!

2024-10-04.name: Kabushikigaisha Magilumiere
2024-10-04.desc:
Sakuragi Kana is an excellent candidate for the job. Any job! She's motivated and organized, and has a fantastic memory. So why has she interviewed at over 15 companies without receiving a single offer? She's trying to keep a positive attitude, but it seems like her bad luck is only getting worse when a monster crashes her latest interview. As havoc ensues, she finds herself helping the magical girl who comes to their rescue and ends up with more than just her life in return. Meet the newest magical girl at Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.!

Source: Viz

2024-10-04.name: Mecha-ude (2024)
2024-10-04.desc:
One day, Amatsuga Hikaru, a junior high school student living in Kitakagami City, meets the mysterious "Ude"-shaped mechanical life form Alma. Alma attempts to bind to Hikaru's body in order to obtain energy from him, but fails. To his surprise, it binds to the hoodie that Hikaru was wearing. Meanwhile, the "Kagami Group," a large corporation that plans to enslave the Mecha-Udes and turn them into weapons, is in pursuit of Alma. ARMS, an organization working to save and free the Mecha-Udes, also searches for Alma. Hikaru, unable to abandon the weakened Alma, puts on the hoodie that Alma has bonded with and gets caught up in the great events unfolding among the Mecha-Ude users......

Source: Official Website

Note: The first two episodes premiered on 10 August 2024 at Anime Matsuri in Houston, Texas. Additionally, the first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 28 September 2024 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 4 October 2024.

2024-10-04.name: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan - Kyoto Douran
2024-10-04.desc: Note: The first four episodes received an early screening at a special event on 22 September 2024 at TOHO Cinemas Nihonbashi in Tokyo and at T-Joy Kyoto in Kyoto. The regular TV broadcast started on 4 October 2024.

2024-10-04.name: Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei
2024-10-04.desc:
* Based on an action fantasy light novel series written by Nagashima Hiroaki and illustrated by Ichimaru Kisuke.

After living a long life as the strongest and oldest dragon, he is slain by a human hero. He awakes to find himself reborn as a human, Dolan, in a remote village. He works hard as a farmer and sometimes hunts for food. His life is simple in this small village, but he is surrounded by love. He soon finds happiness he'd never experienced in his life as a dragon. However, dangerous monsters are lurking around his village lately and he goes to the woods to investigate when he finds out an army of monsters are heading his way...

Source: Alpha Manga

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 18 August 2024 at Shinjuku Wald 9 in Tokyo. The regular broadcast started on 4 October 2024.

2024-10-04.name: Trillion Game
2024-10-04.desc:
Old schoolmates Haru and Gaku will do anything to achieve success. And success to them means earning a trillion dollars! But to do so, they'll need to take full advantage of their own unique skills. Haru is a persuasive and confident speaker who can connect with anyone, while Gaku, although awkward, is an expert programmer. Will their combined talents be enough to make their dream a reality?

Source: Crunchyroll

2024-10-05.name: Bleach: Sennen Kessen Hen - Soukoku Tan
2024-10-05.desc:
* Based on an adventure supernatural shounen manga by Kubo Taito.

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 16 September 2024 at Yamano Hall in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 October 2024.

2024-10-05.name: Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite
2024-10-05.desc:
The setting is 15th century Poland. It was a time when heretical ideas lead those to who possessed such a mindset to being burned at the stake for their beliefs. Rafal, a child prodigy, is expected to major in theology, the most important subject at the time, at the university. One day, however, he comes across a mysterious man, and is now studying a possible "truth" in the midst of heretical thought!

Source: M-U

2024-10-05.name: Hu He Yao Shi Lu
2024-10-05.desc:
In a world where humans and demons coexist and fight against each other, people who practice magic and take it as their mission to slay demons and exorcise demons are called demon masters. Qi Xiaoxuan, the captain of the national demon master team, met the prodigal Hu Zi by accident, and the two embarked on a journey to exorcise demons and defend the way of Taoism. Today, the world has experienced five hundred years of peace, and the demons have long been ready to move, casting a haze on their future...

source: bgm.tv\googletranslate

2024-10-05.name: Ooi! Tonbo (2024)
2024-10-05.desc:
Tonbo's life has wildly changed since leaving the island! After starting high school in Kumamoto, she's playing with other junior golfers. While Tonbo plays her freewheeling Tokara golf, the skilled Hinoki is ready to fight back in a fierce showdown.Tonbo's coach decides she'll compete in the Kyushu Women's Championship, and she's ready to grow more...

Source: Amazon

2024-10-05.name: Sword Art Online Alternative: Gun Gale Online II
2024-10-05.desc:
* Based on a spin-off novel series of Kawahara Reki's light novel series Sword Art Online, written by Shigusawa Keiichi and illustrated by Kuroboshi Kouhaku.

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 29 September 2024 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 October 2024.

2024-10-05.name: Touhai: Ura Rate Mahjong Touhai Roku

2024-10-06.name: Blue Lock vs. U-20 Japan
2024-10-06.desc: * Based on a sports manga written by Kaneshiro Muneyuki and drawn by Nomura Yuusuke.

2024-10-06.name: Kimi wa Meido-sama.
2024-10-06.desc:
* Based on a comedy romance slice-of-life manga by Shotan.

Told from childhood that her only worth is as a killer, Yuki had known nothing else except cold efficiency and following orders. Now that she has a chance to leave her past behind, she arrives at the doorstep of Yokoya Hitoyoshi, asking to be employed... as a maid?! Thus begins the journey of a former assassin learning what it means to be 'normal'!

Source: Shogakukan Asia

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 14 September 2024 at Abema Anime Festival in Tokyo. The regular broadcast started on 6 October 2024.

2024-10-06.name: Nanatsu no Taizai: Mokushiroku no Yonkishi (2024)
Party kara Tsuihou Sareta Sono Chiyushi, Jitsu wa Saikyou ni Tsuki
2024-10-06.desc:
Two centuries have passed since a hero defeated the evil Jaryu and saved the world. In one of the many dungeon cities, Raust, a healer scorned and cast out of his party for being too weak, struggles to find his place. Amidst despair, he meets martial artist Narsena, who invites him to form a new party together. With a fresh start and renewed motivation, the two begin their journey to greatness.

Source: Crunchyroll

2024-10-06.name: Ranma 1/2 (2024)
2024-10-06.desc:
Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 3 October 2024 in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 October 2024.

Additionally, the first 12 episodes leaked in early August before the scheduled air date.

2024-10-06.name: Tsuma, Shougakusei ni Naru.
2024-10-06.desc:
Niijima Keisuke is a man who remains broken hearted 10 years after his wife Takae passed away. But one day, an elementary school girl comes to his house and says that she is Takae, reincarnated as a different girl. Now Keisuke is trying to make up for lost time, while Takae struggles as a grade schooler with the mind of a woman in her 40s, trying create situations where she can meet Keisuke.

Source: ANN

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 21 September 2024 at T-Joy Prince Shinagawa in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 October 2024.

2024-10-07.name: Haigakura
2024-10-07.desc: Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 22 September 2024 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 7 October 2024.

2024-10-07.name: Hoshi Furu Oukoku no Nina
2024-10-07.desc:
Nina had a rough start to life, orphaned and stealing to survive, only to be abducted for her unusual lapis lazuli eyes. But to her surprise, her captor, Prince Azure, ordained that she would live the life of a princess...specifically, that of the recently deceased princess-priestess, Alisha, who had her same eyes. Despite her changing fortune, Nina won't give up her old life without a fight. Azure might just be the one to finally match her wits, but how much can she trust him? And can she stop the feelings budding in her heart, knowing she must eventually marry another...?

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 29 September 2024 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular broadcast started on 7 October 2024.

2024-10-07.name: Kamonohashi Ron no Kindan Suiri 2nd Season
2024-10-07.desc:
* Based on a mystery crime manga by Amano Akira.

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 14 September 2024 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 7 October 2024.

2024-10-07.name: MF Ghost (2024)
2024-10-07.desc: * Based on a sport manga by Shigeno Shuuichi.

2024-10-07.name: Neko ni Tensei Shita Ojisan
2024-10-07.desc: Note: The first episode received a month-long early screening starting on 20 July 2024 at Fuji TV's Odaiba Adventure King 2024. The regular TV broadcast started on 7 October 2024.

2024-10-07.name: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii
2024-10-07.desc:
* Based on a romantic crime drama manga by Konishi Asuka.

Yoshino grew up the sheltered yakuza princess of the largest crime family in Osaka, the Somei. Due to her resting bitch face and dangerous family, no man has ever approached her. When her grandfather signs a truce with the Tokyo-based Miyama crime family, he offers her up as a truce bride to the Miyama leader's grandson! Miyama Kirishima is popular, charming, and seems totally normal.

But behind his smile is a violent sadomasochist who thirsts for her dominance even more when she impresses him with her moxie! Even though she knows how bad yakuza can be, she's stunned by Miyama's viciousness. She can't turn him down with the East-West peace treaty on the line...so instead she steels herself to play ball!

Source: Seven Seas Entertainment

2024-10-08.name: Houkago Shounen Hanako-kun (2024)
2024-10-08.desc: * Based on a supernatural comedy shounen manga by Aida Iro.

2024-10-08.name: Seirei Gensouki 2
2024-10-08.desc:
* Based on a fantasy light novel series written by Kitayama Yuuri and illustrated by Riv.

Note: The first episode received an advance release on Firecross from 30 September 2024 to 2 October 2024. The regular TV broadcast started on 8 October 2024.

2024-10-08.name: Youkai Gakkou no Sensei Hajimemashita!
2024-10-08.desc:
Rookie teacher Abe Haruaki is as cowardly as they come. It's hard enough for him to handle human students without whimpering-and now he's going to be teaching at a school full of monsters?! It's a classroom of horrors for Haruaki, as his mischievous students use every means at their disposal to prank him! Will this poor teacher be able to get his group of ghouls under control, or is this class destined for failure?

Source: Yen Press

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 5 October 2024 at Shinjuku Wald 9 in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 8 October 2024.

2024-10-09.name: Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika o Kouryakuchuu
2024-10-09.desc:
* Based on a romantic shoujo light novel series written by Nagase Sarasa and illustrated by Fuji Mitsuya.

Jill is sentenced to death by the crown prince, her fiancé. But just before she dies, she's sent back in time six years to the party where their engagement had been decided. To avoid this route of ruin, Jill immediately proposes to the person standing behind her...but it's the man who was her greatest enemy, Emperor Hadis?! Jill knows all about his future descent into evil. She quickly retracts the proposal, but the delighted Hadis takes her back to his castle and makes her a meal. Completely won over by the food, Jill makes a life-changing decision...

Source: Cross Infinite World

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 20 September 2024 at Animate Ikebukuro in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 9 October 2024.

2024-10-10.name: Dadao Chaotian
2024-10-10.desc:
Walking through the green mountains, one is still young. Looking back suddenly, the sword has just been removed from the eyebrows, but it is still in the heart. Jing Jiu, who lives in seclusion in a mountain village in Chaotian Continent, unexpectedly takes Liu Shisui, who is born with Tao, as his servant. The two came to Qingshan Sect by chance, but because the "ordinary" Jing Jiu actually took the "extraordinary" genius Liu Shisui as a servant, they were criticized. At the Chengjian Conference, Jing Jiu also met Zhao Layue, a "three-no" girl from Shenmo Peak. The "lazy" Jing Jiu just wanted to practice quietly, but he didn't know that fate would involve the three of them in a huge dispute in the rivers and lakes... Under the great void, is the green mountain far away? Not far.

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2024-10-10.name: Tono to Inu
2024-10-10.desc: Note: The show aired in four versions, each with a different voice actor voicing Tono. The four versions are known as Tono to Inu: Wanwan (Tono voiced by Ootsuka Akio), Tono to Inu: Potepote (Tono voiced by Sugita Tomokazu), Tono to Inu: Kunkun (Tono voiced by Takeuchi Shunsuke), and Tono to Inu: Mofumofu (Tono voiced by Aiba Masaki). The four versions are otherwise identical.

2024-10-11.name: Dragon Ball Daima
2024-10-11.desc:
"Hello. I'm Akira Toriyama.
I'm currently working on a new Dragon Ball.
The title is "Dragon Ball DAIMA".
"DAIMA" is a made-up term, which in Japanese characters would be "大魔" or in English would be something like "Evil."
Due to a conspiracy, Goku and his friends are turned small.
In order to fix things, they'll head off to a new world!
It's a grand adventure with intense action in an unknown and mysterious world.
Since Goku has to make up for his petite size, he uses his Nyoibo (Power Pole) to fight, something not seen in a long time.
I came up with the story and settings, as well as a lot of the designs.
I'm actually putting a lot more into this than usual!
Things will unfold that close in on the mysteries of the Dragon Ball world.
Hope you all enjoy these different-from-usual battles that are cute and powerful!!

-Akira Toriyama

2024-10-13.name: Maou 2099
2024-10-13.desc:
* Based on a cyberpunk humorous fantasy light novel series written by Murasaki Daigo and illustrated by Kureta.

The cyberpunk metropolis Shinjuku—a massive city-state bedecked with neon signs, towering skyscrapers, and the latest cutting-edge technology. It is here, in year 2099 of the Fused Era, where the legendary Demon Lord Veltol has his second coming five centuries in the making. But this landscape is nothing like the one he conquered all those years ago, for the fusion of magic and engineering has elevated civilization to dazzling, unprecedented heights. Veltol may have been reduced to a historical footnote, but make no mistake...this brave new world will be his for the taking!

Source: Yen Press

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 14 September 2024 at United Cinemas Toyosu in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 13 October 2024.

2024-10-13.name: Shangri-La Frontier: Kusogee Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to Su (2024)
2024-10-13.desc: Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 21 September 2024 at KYOMAF in Kyoto. Additionally, the first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 5 October 2024 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 13 October 2024.

2024-10-14.name: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Season 3
2024-10-14.desc:
* Based on a light novel series written by Shirakome Ryou and illustrated by Takayaki.

Note: The first episode received an early screening on 5 July 2024 at Anime Expo in Los Angeles. The regular TV broadcast started on 14 October 2024.

2024-10-14.name: Bananya: Around the World
2024-10-14.desc:
Bananya returns! The mysterious cat who lives inside a banana is back for a new adventure when a ball of light appears. After the ball flashes, a new cat named Baby Sweet emerges. The two quickly become friends and set off on a grand adventure to discover new and exciting places around the world. Join the new friends on their journey!

Source: Crunchyroll

2024-10-14.name: Zongmen Li Chule Wo Dou Shi Wodi
2024-10-14.desc:
In a captivating tale of sacrifice and rebirth, a brilliant hacker named Chen Ning dies to save humanity from a rogue AI, only to be reincarnated as the leader of a powerful sect in a realm of immortal cultivation. Chen Ning must maintain a low profile while handling new responsibilities and guarding against spies within his sect and the encroaching AI threat. Hidden beneath his cold exterior is a deep care for others, as he navigates a world of martial arts, mystical powers, and political intrigue. With the mysterious system agent Jiang Que at his side, Chen Ning unleashes his true potential and commands both allies and foes. As hidden truths of this mystical world reveal themselves, Chen Ning races against time, merging his hacking prowess with newfound mystical abilities, to thwart an impending apocalypse and save another world from destruction.

source: themoviedb.org

2024-10-17.name: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Fukushuu no Requiem
Shan Shantian Tianjian
2024-10-17.desc:
In this fantasy world, where everyone is human and retains their animal features, the inhabitants live a peaceful life. For his next book, novelist Su Bai comes to the hometown of his good friend Avena Nanxia, a terraced village far away in the mountains, where he meets the lively and lovely Cu Nian Nian. Farming, picking, eating, catching fish ...... The daily life in the mountains and fields is always interesting.

source: bgm.tv\DeepL

2024-10-19.name: Ao no Miburo
2024-10-19.desc:
* Based on an action historical manga by Yasuda Tsuyoshi.

Nio is an orphan who can't help dreaming of a better world. He meets two men who show him how much a few swords can change history.

Source: Kodansha

Note: The first episode received an early screening on 4 July 2024 at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, and on 5 October 2024 at Anime Festival Kassel in Germany. Additionally, the first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 9 October 2024 at Ikebukuro Humax Cinemas in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 19 October 2024.

2024-10-22.name: Shendao Dizun
2024-10-22.desc:
Qin Yang, a young man with exceptional talents, possesses the coveted mystic artifact, the "Star Gate", which drew envy from others. Unfortunately, this treasure is taken away. As he approaches death, the dormant treasure within him, the "Divine Pearl", begins to awaken. At that moment, he regains memories from his past nine lives, and embarks on a new journey. Meanwhile, his family faces an unprecedented crisis. Enduring numerous trials, Qin Yang, with the experience and wisdom from his previous lives, takes charge and overcomes obstacle after obstacle. Unbeknownst to them, the conspirators continue their relentless pursuit. Nevertheless, Qin Yang, with his unwavering dedication to protecting his loved ones, chooses to fight on.

source: themoviedb.org

With determination and courage, Xiao Yun, a mortal boy, joins the battle for the qualification of the emperor with the help of the epiphany system. But why did the emperor know him a million years ago? Why did he leave notes in the future? What is the true origin of the epiphany system? All parallel worlds will face a huge crisis, and the only savior is the boy from Earth summoned by the gods!

source: MAL

2024-10-27.name: Mushen Ji
2024-10-27.desc:
In the Disabled Elderly Village, there live nine elderly people with unpredictable origins and the young man Qin Mu they raised. One day, the cows that Qin Mu was responsible for grazing began to speak human words. From then on, Qin Mu became more aware of the dangers and beauty of Daxu, a land abandoned by gods: demons descended with darkness, divine bones danced in the ruins, and dragon bones protected their young, a giant ship that drags the sun... No matter what kind of danger he faces, Qin Mu is fearless. He has integrated the skills passed down by the Nine Elders and vowed to carve out a world with his unparalleled hegemony.

source: MAL

Gao Leng Dao Zun, the number one god in the universe, recruits young girls who will surely become big bosses in the future as his disciples, and leads them on an adventurous journey to change the universe towards destruction. 2024-10-29.name: Chang Sheng Jie
2024-10-29.desc:
This animation is adapted from the novel Changshengjie by Chen Dong, a platinum-winning author from Qidian. Who in the world can be immortal? No matter how beautiful and charming you are, you will eventually become a skeleton; no matter how proud you are, you will eventually turn into a handful of yellow earth. The story mainly tells that Xiao Chen was hunted by Zhao Lin'er, the royal goddess, and accidentally entered the wild dragon island in Changshengjie. This is a dead end where he can't return home. On the strange road, trapped beasts and enemies are overwhelming, and everyone is an enemy. The attachment to relatives, friends and hometown has always supported him to fight and venture in this foreign world, fight strange beasts and kill enemies. In the passionate battle, the temptation of passion and desire, Xiao Chen pursues the footsteps of the immortals and slowly unveils the veil of an ancient mythological world that has been sealed for endless years...
